children: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) rolled out a hardware and AI surge—A20 Pro chip, iPhone 18 Pro and $2,000 foldable iPhone Duo, Watch Series 12/Ultra 4, AirPods 5 and Apple Intelligence—sparking bullish upgrade hopes amid mixed analyst cuts and a modest post-reveal share dip.
Previous Week Recap
AAPL Unveiled A20 Pro Chip
: AAPL unveiled A20 Pro chip for iPhone 18 Pro: 2nm process, GPU/CPU upgrades, dual 32‑core Neural Engines, ~50% higher memory bandwidth. Shares fell about 1.5% after the reveal.
AAPL Pre/Postmarket Rise On New Lineup
: AAPL rose ~1% premarket and later about 2.6% after Apple unveiled a $2,000 foldable iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro, AirPods 5 and Apple Watch Series 12; traders cited device lineup.
Apple Upgrade Cycle, Foldable Potential

: Traders: Apple (AAPL) could see a multiyear upgrade cycle from new hardware, AI features, and a potential foldable iPhone. ~300M iPhones overdue, 1.5B iPhone base, foldable may hit 15–20% Pro sales.
BofA Lowers Target, Raises Forecast

: BofA cut AAPL target to $370 from $380, raised iPhone unit forecast to 256M for FY26–27, trimmed FY27 ASP to $1,099 and cut 2027 EPS to $9.98, citing softer iPhone pricing and higher component costs
Kalshi Plans Apple Futures
: Kalshi plans 24/7 leveraged perpetual futures for Apple Inc. (AAPL), offering nonstop leveraged exposure; launching single-stock perpetuals requires joint SEC and CFTC approval.
AAPL Watch Series 12 And Ultra 4
: AAPL launched Watch Series 12 ($399) and Ultra 4 ($799) for pre-order, ships Sept 18. S11 chip, improved ECG and frequent HR measures, HRV tracking, Readiness/Health Age, Ultra 4: 50h battery.
Citi: iPhone Duo Biggest Hardware
: Citi calls Apple’s iPhone Duo the biggest new hardware category since Watch and AirPods. Citi says Apple raised iPhone 16/17 prices for memory costs and iPhone 18 pricing met expectations.
JPMorgan Overweight On Apple
: JPMorgan kept an overweight on Apple (AAPL), noting higher component costs offset by strong upgrade demand and forecasting Apple could take about 44% of this year’s foldable‑phone revenue.
Premium iPhone 18 First; Base Delayed
: Apple (AAPL) will debut premium-priced iPhone 18 models first; a lower-priced base model is delayed to next year due to rising memory costs squeezing margins.
Apple Intelligence: Siri Upgraded

: Apple (AAPL) unveiled Apple Intelligence: upgraded Siri using on‑device and cloud compute plus third‑party models to run cross‑app actions and multi‑step tasks, blending local and external resources.
